releases.body:
Sub-50 ms hook and MCP hot path, project X-Ray and symbol decision recall,
1-tool `deja` MCP mode guidance and argument aliases across harnesses, OpenCode
2.x plugin upgrade handling, and asymmetric Nemotron / NVIDIA NIM embeddings.

### Added

- `deja orient` and `PreToolUse` surface co-change file pairs, symbol decisions, and verified traps. Pre-flight hooks also surface targeted test priority and command remedies before an agent edits or runs a command (#5882, #5896).
- `PreCompact` captures modified files and symbol decisions so compaction keeps the active working set. `apply_patch` edits are also indexed into file blame and history (#5896).
- `deja embed` supports asymmetric NVIDIA NIM and Nemotron models with automatic `input_type` retry. Passes `"passage"` when indexing and `"query"` when searching (#5950).
- Native Antigravity plugin bundle (`antigravity-plugin/`) and `deja stats --card` on first install.
- Configuration reference for `~/.config/deja` and `policy.json`, plus JetBrains AI and session-deletion guides (#5869, #5943).

### Changed

- Hook and MCP recall bound session record reads to tail windows and skip unused tool-output inflation. Transcript change scans prefilter by mtime, and compressed `.jsonl.zst` Codex rollouts stream without holding them in memory (#5901, #5907, #5908, #5927, #5928).

### Fixed

- Hook leads and `/deja` prompts name 1-tool `deja` modes (`"context"` and `"recall"`), and `spreadQ` accepts subject aliases (`session_id`, `file_path`, `output`, `fact`). `dejaCallNames` also recognizes MCP-prefixed `deja` tool calls.
- `deja install opencode-auto` replaces the legacy OpenCode 1.x TUI status plugin with the 2.x server plugin on upgrade, and registers `home_bottom` before `home-tips`.
- `deja doctor` detects approved Codex hooks from non-primary event pins and live hook execution in `.live` / `.hookseen` (#5948).
- Hook concurrency, detached refreshers, and CLI flag validation handle spawn recall locks, `.hookseen` serialization, Windows path separators, `recap --json --limit`, and blank arguments in `promote`, `remember --project`, `handoff`, `fix`, `view --out`, and `restore -o` (#5899, #5904, #5909, #5910, #5911, #5915, #5929, #5930, #5931, #5932, #5933, #5945, #5949).
- `go test ./...` runs hermetically in root and minimal containers without `sqlite3` or `zstd` installed (#5947).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(antigravity): add native antigravity-plugin bundle for marketplace
* feat(embed): send input_type for asymmetric Nemotron and NVIDIA NIM models
* feat(hook): add symbol decision recall, targeted test priority, and pre-flight remedies
* feat(install): mention deja stats --card in first-install proof line
* feat(orient,hook): surface project X-Ray, co-change pairs, and verified traps (#5882)
* feat: compaction edit ledger, apply_patch file history, and recall signal filtering (#5896)
### Fixes
* fix(cli): handle positional arguments after --
* fix(cli): quote Windows test path and tighten flag parsing and completions
* fix(cmd): serialize in-process hook state and restore how dash-query hint
* fix(cmd,sources): restore test refresher sentinel, cross-platform pid check, and fast antigravity changes
* fix(codex): assign err on its own line, as the linter asks (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(codex): satisfy the shadow lint and cover the rest of zstdScan (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(codex): stream a compressed rollout instead of holding it in memory (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(doctor): detect approved Codex hooks from non-primary pins and live execution
* fix(dsh,usage): retain opening digest across refreshContext and update log JSON contract (#5904, #5899)
* fix(fix): ignore blank arguments in the error text (#5911) (@ZYZ666-RGB)
* fix(hook): a detached refresh takes the warmup's budget (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(hook): a refresher waiting on the index lock is not replaced (@Sora-bluesky)
* fix(hook): normalize path separators in commandProjectCandidates on Windows (#5915)
* fix(hooks): bound prompt candidat

releases.body:
Built from 419e45ff on 2026-11-05.

Unreleased code — use a tagged release unless you are testing something specific.

Download with: gh release download nightly

### Added

- **VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Antigravity extension (`vshulcz.deja-status`, `extensions/vscode`).** Shows a live session memory counter in the status bar and runs `deja stats` or `deja install --auto` on click (#5859).
- **Raycast extension (`extensions/raycast`).** Adds `Search Sessions` and `Recent Sessions` commands on macOS for searching across all indexed coding agent sessions and copying `deja resume <id>` (#5829).
- **`deja-reflect` skill (`skills/deja-reflect/SKILL.md`).** Standalone end-of-session reflection skill that inspects `deja notes` and `deja friction`, distills durable project invariants, and stores confirmed notes via `deja remember` (#5841).
- **Incremental offset parsing for Antigravity and Cursor transcripts** and symbol-level blame in `deja blame` (#5863).

### Fixed

- **Status line multi-harness audit** across OpenCode, Antigravity, Claude Code, and Cursor (`statusline`), plus `recall_context` tool name alignment in `hook-context` and `deja doctor` self-version check (#5850, #5851, #5864).
- **Claude Code and Codex plugin hooks (`claude-plugin/hooks/deja.sh`, `codex-plugin/hooks/deja.sh`).** Require explicit confirmation before acting on recalled `User said (this project)` lines or running `deja rules sync`, and point missing-binary hints solely at `brew install deja-vu` (#5838, #5860, #5865).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(sources,search): incremental offset parsing for antigravity/cursor and symbol blame (#5863)
* feat: resolve remaining open issues across recall, statusline, stats, docs and extensions (#5864)
### Fixes
* fix(claude-plugin,codex-plugin): drop moving @latest from missing-binary hint (#5865)
* fix(claude-plugin,hooks): require confirmation on recalled user lines and rules sync (#5838) (#5860)
### Performance
* perf(index,digest): cut relevance allocations 4x, cache worktree roots, and enforce wiring invariants (#5835)
### Documentation
* docs(changelog,extensions): prepare 0.23.5 release and align extension READMEs (#5878)
* docs(guide): put index-before-delete and write-back commands at the top of cleanup and recovery guides (#5834) (@shu-chen-dot-ca)
* docs(readme,extensions,site): symmetric conversion, nav star CTA, CITATION.cff, and context7.json (#5848) (#5861)
### Other
* chore: pin the manifests to 0.23.4 (#5828)
* refactor(cli,index,digest,search): split hook/store/digest domains and fix Unicode word boundaries (#5844)
* refactor(cli,index,search,redact): split 10 domain files into cohesive units under 1,980 lines (#5845)
* refactor(cli,index,search,sources): split 9 domain files so zero files exceed 1,359 lines (#5846)
* refactor(cli,sources,digest): unify hook envelope adoption, word-form counting, and duplicate helpers (#5840)
* refactor(index,deja): unify synced convention conversion and OrigID identity lookup (#5853)
* refactor(index,search,cli): split bounded domains and enforce cross-package invariants (#5839)
* refactor(model,index,deja): unify session lineage and decision lifecycle resolution (#5852)
* refactor(model,query): introduce DDD domain value methods, unify ProjectInScope, and enforce AST invariants (#5849)
* refactor: unify harness wiring, parser project ACL, and index sidecar updates (#5855)
* refactor: unify identity resolution, handover filters, and sidecar scope (#5854)
* refactor: unify manifest visibility, index exclusion gate, and composite identity (DDD Stages E-K) (#5858)

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/main/install.sh | sh
go install github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/cmd/deja@v0.23.5
brew install deja-vu
```

Reverse commit attribution (`deja origin`), shell-layer recall (`deja shell`)
for agents whose MCP or hook channel is absent or broken, full CJK recall and
decision extraction parity, and expanded harness wiring and session-deletion
guides across the 43 supported agents.

### Added

- `deja origin [rev|range]` traces commits back to the coding agent session and
  user prompt that produced them across all 43 harnesses, matching git author
  timestamps and changed file paths against indexed tool edits (`--json`,
  `--harness`, `--project`, `--limit`) (#534).
- `deja shell` adds a shell-level recall channel independent of harness MCP or
  hook support: `eval "$(deja shell zsh|bash|fish)"` installs preexec/postexec
  hooks that surface prior command warnings and post-failure fix pairs,
  `deja shell -c "<cmd>"` wraps command execution directly (`SHELL=deja`), and
  `deja shell --verify [--json]` probes live MCP stdio `initialize` and
  `tools/list` call-through across every wired harness (#1214).
- Continue CLI (`cn`) hook wiring (`UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, `Stop`,
  `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreCompact`) in `~/.continue/config.yaml` and
  `~/.continue/settings.json` (#5798).
- Guide pages for deleting session history in Goose, Gemini CLI, Aider, Hermes
  (with @beiryu) and Crush (with @Kasa-Harendra), plus updated `deja delete`
  guides (#5571, #5643, #5645, #5646, #5647, #4968).

### Changed

- CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) queries, decision markers, correction cues,
  and error signatures now tokenize and rank on par with English and Russian:
  punctuation-free CJK prompts keep query tokens intact, `CarriesDecision` and
  `HasFact` recognize Chinese architectural and root-cause markers (`决定`,
  `改成`, `根因`, `排查`, `修复`, `原因`, `方案`, `不能`, `必须`), and
  cross-session recall surfaces Chinese decisions and fix pairs (#5777, #5791,
  #5804).
- VS Code fork family (Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Antigravity, CodeBuddy, Qoder,
  PearAI, Void, Melty, Aide) shares unified `state.vscdb` and `workspaceStorage`
  session discovery (#5797).

### Fixed

- `deja install` and `deja doctor` handle symlinked harness config paths,
  custom `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` / `CODEX_HOME` roots, Qwen Code `settings.json`
  hook coexistence, and Cursor workspace database WAL locks cleanly (#4971,
  #3784, #4976, #528).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(claude): ingest claude-mem SQLite observations and summaries
* feat(cli): add deja origin commit provenance command (#5819)
* feat(cli): show one-time star hint after 25 recalls in stats and install
* feat(docs): add install method tabs, full-guide search, and top-page index callouts (#5788)
* feat(embed,search): fuse vector-first RRF hits, rerank 64 pool, and skip regex (#5777)
* feat(hook,fix,doctor): surface co-changed companions, edit fix diffs, and stale plugin scripts (#5779)
* feat(hooks): carry Claude auto-memory to non-Claude sessions and fix Hermes/mcode (#5818)
* feat(index,sources,handoff): add shared index perms, DEJA_HOME_ROOTS, and handoff state (#5780)
* feat(recall): tighten prompt hook subject gates and lift marathon session-start coverage (#5781)
* feat(recall,search,prompt): surface code edit diffs, diversify uncovered terms, and mark touched-file supersession (#5778)
* feat(scripts): add amlserve HTTP adapter for AML evaluation (#5755)
* feat(shell): add shell-layer recall and MCP call-through verification (#1214) (#5824)
* feat(sources): resolve Gemini workspace for changes and refresh live-verified registry entries (#5821)
* feat(sources,cli): add project-scoped .deja/notes.jsonl store and --repo promotion (#5816)
* feat(statusline): wire status bar item across VS Code forks
* feat: add CJK episode classification and cross-script retrieval (#5802)
* feat: collapse worktree file paths and inherit Antigravity subagent projects (#5811)
### Fixes
* fix(brief,recap,ci): clean recap cuts and brief noise, group codeql bumps (#5790)
* fix(digest): skip home and root directories in ProjectNameCa

Recalled code changes keep library edits ahead of `*_test.py` files and leave
out scratch `*_test.py` files written outside a test directory.

### Fixed

- `FinalChanges` classifies `*_test.py` files alongside `test_*.py` as tests,
  so library edits appear before test edits in a recalled session's code changes
  and scratch `*_test.py` files outside a test directory are left out (#5751).

### Changed

- The README, architecture guide, roadmap and site lead with `codex`,
  `opencode`, `cursor` and `claude` on equal footing, and internal benchmark
  stands were removed from `scripts/` (#5751).
- The release follow-up workflow opens the manifest and extension version
  catch-up pull request automatically when `RELEASE_PIN_TOKEN` is set (#5749).

## Changelog
### Other
* chore: drop one-off measurement probes and local harness stands (#5751)
* chore: pin the manifests to 0.23.2 (#5746)
* ci: release follow-up opens the manifest pin PR itself (#5749)

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/main/install.sh | sh
go install github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/cmd/deja@v0.23.3
brew install deja-vu
```
